summary: Wednesday: TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT earnings reactions at open. Iran ceasefire expires tonight. US PMI Flash. META reports AMC. VIX 18.9 (-3.1%). SPY/QQQ new 52w highs but binary risk dominates. Barbell positioning: AI value + energy/commodities.

risks.label: Mega-Cap Earnings Reactions (Wed Open)
risks.detail: TSLA, GOOGL, MSFT reported after Tuesday close. Combined $6T+ market cap. Pre-market futures will determine whether the 52w high breakout extends or reverses. Any major miss triggers broad selloff and VIX spike to 22+.

risks.label: Iran Ceasefire Expiry (Wednesday)
risks.detail: US-Iran ceasefire expires Wednesday evening. If negotiations fail, oil spikes above $95 WTI and VIX targets 22+. USO at $129 already pricing in disruption. Energy positions (SLB, EQNR) hedge this scenario directly.

risks.label: EARLY RISK-OFF Regime Persists
risks.detail: AutoScreener regime score 0.55 (EARLY RISK-OFF). VIX component bearish despite drop to 18.9. Three binary catalysts in one session = elevated uncertainty. Position sizing at 0.75x. Watch VIX 22 as full RISK-OFF trigger.

risks.label: FOMC Apr 28-29 — Rate Decision
risks.detail: Fed expected to hold at 3.50-3.75%. Statement language on inflation and rate cut timing will move markets. Oil rebound complicates disinflation narrative. Hawkish surprise = growth multiple compression.

risks.label: META Q1 Earnings (Wednesday AMC)
risks.detail: Meta reports Wednesday after close, completing mega-cap earnings cluster. AI capex guidance and ad revenue growth are key. Any weakness compounds morning TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT reactions.

events.label: TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT Reactions (Wed Open)
events.detail: Three mega-caps reported tonight. Pre-market futures between 4-9:30 AM ET will set the tone. Combined $6T+ market cap. Bull case: all beat → VIX to 16, regime upgrades. Bear case: miss → VIX 22+.
